ON THE 18 th OF AUGUST, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 35231 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 BALMUKUNDRA SHARMA S/O LATE SHRI JAGNNATH  PRASAD SHARMA, AGED ABOUT 59 YEARS,
 OCCUPATION: THEKEDARI, R/O NAHAR ROAD  GADAIPURA, BIRLANAGAR GWALIOR MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI RAJ KUMAR SINGH PAVIYA- ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  THANA MAHARAJPURA, DISTRICT GWALIOR  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI ROHIT MISHRA- ADDITIONAL ADVOCATE GENERAL FOR THE  STATE AND SHRI ABHINAV BHARGAV, LEARNED COUNSEL FOR THE  RESPONDENT [COMP]).
 This application coming on for admission this day, the  following:
 ORDER

Learned counsel for the applicant seeks for and is granted permission to withdraw this first bail application filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Crime No.364/2023 registered at Police Station Maharajpura, District Gwalior (M.P.) for offence under Sections 406 & 420 of IPC with liberty to surrender before the trial Court and to file regular bail application before the trial court.
If any such bail application is filed before the trial Court then trial Court is directed to decide the same as expeditiously as possible, if possible on the same day in accordance with law.
